source.title: Retail Trade, Australia, June 2025; Table 11 original turnover by state and industry subgroup
source.attribution: © Commonwealth of Australia, Australian Bureau of Statistics. Adapted from original ABS monthly turnover estimates; no endorsement implied.
source.publication_status: Ceased: June 2025 is the final Retail Trade release. This is historical data, not a continuing 2026 series.
source.limitations: Sample-based geographic/industry aggregates, not individual borrower cash receipts. Shared economic shocks and survey revision vintage create dependence; original values retain seasonality and COVID disruptions.
source.transformation: Original unadjusted monthly nominal sales/turnover, not YTD. Preserve published units, negative observations and null missing/suppressed/unreliable/nonfinite values. Remove national totals and overlapping industry parents; retain at most 240 calendar months. No currency conversion, gap-zero imputation or expense labels.

protocol.grouping: Provider-prefixed state/province; all industry series from one geography stay together. Sector records are dependent aggregate series, not independent firms.
protocol.split_algorithm: SHA256('international-region-v1:' + provider + ':' + geography), sorted; floor(0.6*n) train, half remaining validation/test
protocol.quality_policy: Reject an entire case if any required history/target month is missing, suppressed, unreliable, nonfinite or negative. Published zero sales remain actual zeros; all-zero history is excluded.
protocol.test_policy: Terminal test labels are imported but must not be read for training or validation selection; build test cases only after final model freeze.
